name: Brotli
description: Compress HTTP requests with the brotli algorithm.

USE_BROTLI.help: Enable or disable Brotli compression. Off by default, which is also the ngx_brotli module's own default. The setting is per-service: leave it off for any service whose responses both carry a secret (a CSRF token, an API key) and echo back attacker-supplied input, since that combination is the BREACH precondition — and note that text/html is always compressed, whatever BROTLI_TYPES lists. The BunkerWeb web UI is such a service.
USE_BROTLI.label: Use brotli

BROTLI_TYPES.default: application/atom+xml application/javascript application/json application/rss+xml application/vnd.ms-fontobject application/x-font-opentype application/x-font-truetype application/x-font-ttf application/x-javascript application/xhtml+xml application/xml font/eot font/opentype font/otf font/truetype image/svg+xml image/vnd.microsoft.icon image/x-icon image/x-win-bitmap text/css text/javascript text/plain text/xml
BROTLI_TYPES.help: List of MIME types that will be compressed with brotli.
BROTLI_TYPES.label: MIME types

BROTLI_MIN_LENGTH.help: Minimum response size (in bytes) for Brotli compression to apply.
BROTLI_MIN_LENGTH.label: Minimum length

BROTLI_COMP_LEVEL.help: Compression level for Brotli (0 = no compression, 11 = maximum compression).
BROTLI_COMP_LEVEL.label: Compression level
